summary.intent: Get the updated Entire hooks and setup config (.claude/settings.json and .codex/hooks.json) shipped as a PR via Entire trails, then clean up the worktree and make sure session/checkpoint data from worktrees and branches gets pushed.
summary.outcome: PR #303 was opened from a worktree branch, linked to Entire trail #168, and merged. The worktree, local branch and stale local edits were cleaned up and main was fast-forwarded. A memory rule about pushing sessions before worktree exit was saved, and two outgoing checkpoints from another session were pushed to origin.

repo: Hooks config lives in .claude/settings.json and .codex/hooks.json; SessionStart hooks in both now run `entire --version` and warn if the binary fails.
The repo keeps a trail-planning rule: show the plan and get a yes before creating a trail, branch or PR.
Untracked .playwright-mcp/ and apps/validate/ in the main checkout are unrelated to the hooks change and were deliberately left out.
gh calls go through a Touch ID shim (and rtk), so `gh pr create` blocks until the user approves; it needs a literal path for --body-file, since $TMPDIR is not expanded.
workflow: `entire trail create --no-branch` creates an intent-only trail; `entire trail link <n> --branch <b> --base main` then reuses the existing PR instead of creating a duplicate.
Entire merge gates (approvals, checks, findings) can be inspected with `entire trail show <n> --json`; the PR was merged via the Entire UI.
Checkpoints sync with `git push`, but session activity after a branch's last commit is not captured unless you commit and push again.
`entire checkpoint list --outgoing` shows unpushed checkpoints; `entire checkpoint push <id>@<sha>` pushes specific ones.
Before discarding local edits after a merge, fetch origin main and diff the files against FETCH_HEAD to confirm they are identical.
The sandbox protects .claude/settings.json, so copying it into a worktree required running with the sandbox off.

friction: Writing .claude/settings.json into the worktree was blocked by the sandbox, so the first `git apply` and cp attempts did not work.
The `$TMPDIR` path was not accepted as --body-file for the first `gh pr create`; it needed a literal /tmp/claude-501 path.
The Touch ID approval for `gh pr create` stalled the flow until the user approved.
The user's 'Can't we just use entire properly for this?' was ambiguous (PR flow vs. regenerating hook files), and it was never clarified because the conversation moved on.
The session's post-commit discussion had no checkpoint, since the worktree was removed before it was pushed.
open_items: The hooks files were not verified as reproducible output of an Entire command (e.g. `entire enable`) and no such command was identified.
This session's post-commit activity has no checkpoint; a catch-up commit/PR was offered but not made.
An automatic pre-worktree-removal hook to push sessions was offered but not set up; only a memory rule exists.
Untracked .playwright-mcp/ and apps/validate/ remain in the main checkout.
